name: Dust Bunny Swarm
source: Paizo Blog: Foolish Housekeeping and Other Articles

defensiveAbilities.name: Cloud of Allergens
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The swarm rolls initiative

Effect The dust bunnies stir, kicking up a cloud in a 15ft Type:burst centered on the swarm that lasts for 1 minute. Creatures who enter or start their turn in this cloud must attempt a DC 16 Fortitude Saving Throw save or take a –1 circumstance penalty to skill checks that have the concentration trait and all Perception checks as their sensory organs become impaired.

Effect: Cloud of Allergens

defensiveAbilities.name: Dust to Dust
defensiveAbilities.description: When a dust bunny swarm is destroyed, it re-forms after 2d4 days in the area in which it was destroyed unless the location has been significantly cleaned of all dust and debris.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pummeling Dust
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 1d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage with a Basic DC 16 Reflex Saving Throw save. A creature that fails its save cannot use reactions for 1 round as they sneeze uncontrollably.
